name: Top Products
definition:
d_next = d
# d : the rows the user may read, already filtered by the panel period and dimensions ; line 1 must stay `out = in`
# confirmed orders
d_next = d_next.filter(~pl.col("state").is_in(["draft", "sent", "cancel"]) & pl.col("product_id").is_not_null())
# n_unique : an order has several lines ; product_id_ (the id) is kept to build the link
d_next = d_next.group_by(["product_id", "product_id_"]).agg([pl.col("order_id_").n_unique().alias("Orders"), pl.col("price_subtotal").sum().alias("Revenue")])
# the last sort keys only break ties : stable order
d_next = d_next.sort(["Revenue", "product_id"], descending=[True, False]).head(10)
# a "[label](url)" cell is drawn as a link to Odoo : odoo_url is the base url, `product_id_` the id
d_next = d_next.select([
    pl.concat_str([pl.lit("["), pl.col("product_id"), pl.lit("]("), pl.lit(odoo_url), pl.lit("/odoo/product.product/"), pl.col("product_id_").cast(pl.String), pl.lit(")")]).alias("Product"),
    pl.col("Orders"),
    pl.col("Revenue"),
    # hidden column (`__` prefix) : a click on the row hands it to the drill-down as key["product_id_"]
    pl.col("product_id_").alias("__product_id_"),
])
drill:
d_next = d
# key : the hidden columns of the clicked row. Same rows as the tile : confirmed lines of that product
d_next = d_next.filter(~pl.col("state").is_in(["draft", "sent", "cancel"]) & (pl.col("product_id_") == key["product_id_"]))
d_next = d_next.sort(["order_id.date_order", "id"], descending=[True, True])
d_next = d_next.select([
    pl.col("order_id.date_order").alias("Date"),
    pl.concat_str([pl.lit("["), pl.col("order_id"), pl.lit("]("), pl.lit(odoo_url), pl.lit("/odoo/sale.order/"), pl.col("order_id_").cast(pl.String), pl.lit(")")]).alias("Order"),
    pl.col("order_partner_id").alias("Customer"),
    pl.col("product_uom_qty").alias("Quantity"),
    pl.col("price_subtotal").alias("Revenue"),
])

name: Qty sold per salesperson

name: RFQs to send
definition:
where = "state = 'draft'"
ignore_period = true

name: RFQs waiting
definition:
where = "state = 'sent' and date_order >= '{today}'"
ignore_period = true

name: Late RFQs
definition:
where = "state in ('draft', 'sent', 'to approve') and date_order < '{today}'"
ignore_period = true

name: Late receipts
definition:
where = "state in ('purchase', 'done') and receipt_status in ('pending', 'partial') and date_planned < '{today}'"
ignore_period = true

name: Purchased last 7 days
definition:
where = "state in ('purchase', 'done') and date_approve >= '{today-7}'"
aggregation = "sum"
measure = "amount_untaxed"
ignore_period = true

name: Avg order value
definition:
where = "state in ('purchase', 'done')"
aggregation = "mean"
measure = "amount_untaxed"
decimals = 0
compare = true

name: Days to order
definition:
version = 2
where = "state in ('purchase', 'done')"
measure = "days_to_order"
aggregation = "mean"
unit = "days"

[compare]
good = "down"  # fewer days is better

[computed]
days_to_order = "date_approve - create_date"

name: Days to receive
definition:
version = 2
where = "state in ('purchase', 'done')"
measure = "days_to_receive"
aggregation = "mean"
unit = "days"

[compare]
good = "down"  # fewer days is better

[computed]
days_to_receive = "effective_date - date_approve"

name: Quotations
definition:
where = "state in ('draft', 'sent')"
compare = true

name: Orders
definition:
where = "state = 'sale'"
compare = true

name: Revenue
definition:

compare = true
